The '''''Golden City Messenger''''' was a [[Passenger liner|starliner]] with [[Color|gray]] plating.<ref name="CLNE" /> In [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events depicted on the [[Corellia]] page of ''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' to [[13 BBY]].</ref> it was parked on a landing pad between the [[Coronet Spaceport passenger terminal|passenger terminal]] and the [[Spaceport's operation control center|operation control center]] of the [[Coronet City Spaceport|spaceport]] of the [[planet]] [[Corellia]]'s [[Coronet City]],<ref name="CLNE" /> which was also known as the Golden City.<ref name="CrimsonClimb">''[[Crimson Climb]]''</ref> The [[starship]] was bound for the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]<ref name="CLNE" /> planet<ref name="Tarkin">[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']]</ref> [[Eriadu]],<ref name="CLNE" /> but was still on the landing pad when the [[scrumrat]]s [[Han Solo|Han]] and [[Qi'ra]] entered the [[spaceport]].<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''Golden City Messenger'' first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> It was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'',<ref name="CLNE" /> the new material for which was written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Emily Shkoukani]].<ref name="Bluesky">{{Bluesky|jasoncfry.bsky.social|post/3ljusdhg5mc26|[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-03-08|quote=Just got a copy of the newly revised Star Wars: Complete Locations from DK, out Tuesday! I wrote the updates with the peerless @shkouks.bsky.social. You'll find 12 new artworks, an updated galaxy map, new and reworked planet profiles, and details and Easter eggs galore. And a glorious cover!|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/CJuwQ|archivefile=File:JasonFry-CompleteLocationsNewEdition-Bluesky.png}} {{C|@shkouks.bsky.social confirmed to be [[Emily Shkoukani]] by {{Bluesky|tarkinstopshelf.bsky.social|post/3kjlh6aw5ry2k|[[Tarkin's Top Shelf]]|date=2024-01-22|quote=New Episode! #296: Dawn of Rebellion with @shkouks.bsky.social and @infinata.bsky.social! Your hosts welcome Emily Shkoukani and Pablo Hidalgo to the show! They discuss the creative process behind the Visual Guide and get to know their guests with some fun #StarWars questions!📚|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/eePoa|archivefile=File:TarkinsTopShelf-Shkoukani-Bluesky.png}}}}</ref>
